jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description: Cyber Security Analyst Company: JobSPhere Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Compensation: Performance-Based, up to ₹25,000/- About the Company JobSPhere is a technology-driven organization focused on delivering innovative IT solutions and helping businesses strengthen their digital infrastructure. We believe in leveraging modern technologies to create secure, reliable, and efficient digital environments. About the Role We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Cyber Security Intern who is interested in protecting digital systems and identifying potential security vulnerabilities. In this role, you will gain hands-on experience in security monitoring, vulnerability analysis, threat detection, and cybersecurity best practices while working on practical projects. Key Responsibilities 🔐 Monitor networks, systems, and applications for potential security threats. Identify vulnerabilities and assist with security assessments. Analyze suspicious activities and potential security incidents. Perform basic security testing under guidance. Research emerging cyber threats, attacks, and security trends. Assist in implementing security measures and preventive practices. Prepare security assessment reports and documentation. Support the team in maintaining system and data security. Eligibility Criteria Pursuing or completed a degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply. Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts and ethical hacking. Interest in learning security tools and technologies. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Required Skills Basic knowledge of computer networks and networking protocols. Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems. Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals. Basic knowledge of tools such as Wireshark, Nmap, or Burp Suite is an advantage. Awareness of common cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Good communication, research, and documentation skills. Perks & Benefits 💰 Performance-based compensation up to ₹25,000/-. 🔍 Hands-on experience with real-world cybersecurity projects. Opportunity to explore industry-relevant security tools. Practical exposure to vulnerability assessment and threat analysis. Professional mentorship and skill development. Opportunities to enhance your technical knowledge and career prospects. Equal Opportunity JobSPhere welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds and is committed to providing equal opportunities. We encourage a collaborative, inclusive, and supportive environment where individuals can learn, contribute, and grow professionally.
